title: Missions (content/rules/missions.json, schema v0)
description: The missions of the game as data: the pools that the daily, weekly and monthly sets are drawn from, and the chains of main missions. How many missions a set has is the number of its slots; what the sets pay in all, when they reset and what the bonus for a whole set is are numbers of the rules (rules/starter.json, section missions). Provisional, like the rules.

effort.description: What the work that a goal asks is worth, in ppm of a tank of the best car of the driver (1 000 000 is a tank): for the goals that are a part of a tank (laps, wet_laps, cash_earned, fuel_spent) the worth of a whole tank of that work, for the others the worth of doing it once (a level, a car, a garage, a part of a rarity are counted the same way; `rarity_owned:rare` is the worth of a part of that rarity, and `rarity_owned` of any other). A mission pays a part of what it is worth (the shares are in the rules, section missions), so what it asks and what it pays go up together. Every goal that a template or a chain uses needs an entry.

periodic.description: The sets that come back: a set of a day, a week or a month has one mission for every slot, drawn from the templates of the slot (by weight, from a seed that is the driver and the period, so that the same driver gets the same set all through the period). A driver draws a set the first time they look in the period.

chains.description: The main missions: a chain is a line of missions that the driver does one after another (the next one opens when the one before it is done), and every chain has one mission at a time, so a driver has several main goals at once. What a mission counts is everything the driver has done, not only what they did after it opened.

objective.description: What a mission counts. Counted over the period: laps (every car of the driver, also while they are away), cash_earned (what the laps paid, in cents; what a mission paid does not count), wet_laps (laps on a wet ground), fuel_spent (cents paid for fuel), upgrade, mount and service (jobs of the workshop that were done), crate (crates of the shop opened; the crates that missions give do not count), parts_bought, journey (journeys that ended) and car_bought (cars bought on the exchange or at the dealer). In a chain they are counted over all the time, and a chain also has repair (repairs after a breakdown), merge (attempts at merging parts), player_level, car_level (the best car), cars_owned, garages_owned, rarity_owned (parts of the rarity in param, or better, owned) and tires_mounted (tires of the kind in param on the car that is played).

items.description: What a mission gives besides cash and XP. A crate is opened for the driver when the reward is taken (the same draw as the shop, with the odds of its kind, but its own count of openings for the guarantees; it costs nothing), and a part is a part of the rarity from the pool of the shop that the level of the driver opens, in a slot that is drawn.

key.description: What the slot is for, for the people who edit it.

templates.description: The missions the slot can draw, by key. Every level of the game has to have at least one that fits it (min_player_level and max_player_level).

tanks_ppm.description: For laps, wet_laps, cash_earned and fuel_spent: how much of a tank of the best car of the driver the goal is (1 000 000 is one full tank: its laps, what they pay, what the fuel costs).

count.description: For the other goals: how many times.

weight.description: How often the slot draws it, against the others of the slot.

reward_share.description: A multiplier on what the mission is worth when the set pays it: 1 pays the part of its worth that the rules give, 2 twice that. Leave it at 1 unless a mission should pay more or less than the work it asks.

car_xp_laps.description: Experience for the car that is played, as many laps of it as this.

text.description: One sentence on what to do and why, in the voice of the game.

count.description: The goal: how many, or the level, or the number of cars. For the facts that are not counted (tires_mounted) it is 1.

param.description: The rarity (rarity_owned) or the kind of tires (tires_mounted) the mission is about.

min_player_level.description: The mission opens only for a driver of this level, whatever the chain has done.

reward.description: What the mission gives besides the part of its worth that the rules pay in cash and XP (section missions, main).

car_xp_laps.description: Experience for the car that is played, as many laps of it as this.
